## Description
Add copy.artifact_dir config key to dso-config.conf.example (default: copy/). Add a path-validation helper that resolves the artifact path safely: reject absolute paths, reject path traversal (..), reject paths outside the project root after resolution. Tests cover good paths, abs-path rejection, traversal rejection.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/test-batched.sh --runner=pytest --test-dir=plugins/dso/tests/scripts/
- [ ] Lint + format pass
  Verify: bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-lint.sh && bash plugins/dso/scripts/dso-format-check.sh
- [ ] dso-config.conf.example contains copy.artifact_dir
  Verify: grep -E 'artifact_dir' dso-config.conf.example
- [ ] Path validator rejects absolute paths
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_copy_artifact_dir.py -k absolute
- [ ] Path validator rejects traversal
  Verify: pytest plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_copy_artifact_dir.py -k traversal

## File Impact
- dso-config.conf.example: Edit
- plugins/dso/scripts/copy_artifact_path.py: Create
- plugins/dso/tests/scripts/test_copy_artifact_dir.py: Create
